fields.subject: Postgres Service Registration
fields.trigger: A host calls PgServiceBuilderExtensions.AddPgServices(services, config) to register PostgreSQL services
fields.response: the call unconditionally assigns QueryStatement.Extension — set through the QueryStatement type itself, not through either PgDatabases or PgShardSets — to "psql", regardless of what value the property held immediately before the call
fields.postcondition: QueryStatement.Extension holds "psql" at the point AddPgServices returns
